verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes its standard processing rates (2.9% + 30¢ domestic, plus published adders for international cards, manual entry and currency conversion), and agent-driven orders reportedly inherit them, so a merchant can estimate the Stripe-side cost without contacting sales. However, the evidence notes that no separate agentic-channel fee schedule is disclosed. Community-quoted material mentions merchants paying an unquantified 'small fee on completed purchases' on the agent platform side, so the full channel cost is not published. Missing for 10: an explicit published fee schedule for ACS/agent-originated transactions (including SPT or agentic token costs), first-party confirmation that agentic orders carry no extra Stripe fee, disclosed agent-platform fees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, the fees for agent-originated transactions are published — I can price agentic channels without asking sales

citations.quote: stripe.com/pricing publishes the flat rates that agent-driven orders inherit
No setup fees, monthly fees, or hidden fees.
